sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop, a drifting walk): stepping forward, the long robe's hem streaming back, the clock on his back, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE HANDS AND THE CLOCK go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): his open hands as the pale figure holds them; the big golden clock with its cream face, teal numerals, pendulum and golden hand on his back, as big as in image 1 (tipping with him as he falls). Only him: no time glow, no sand, no bombs, no rewinding rings; the clock does not glow.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his grey shoe flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the beard, the hands and the clock follow the pale figure. His long robe covers his legs: show each foot stepping out under its hem, the hem swinging with them.
